exact_promoted_claim: retrospective WDI GDP snapshot replay QA with descriptive comparator, no prediction or superiority claim

formula: replay latest non-null WDI value from pinned World Bank snapshot and compute residual against the same parsed value
negative_controls: remove or corrupt the latest WDI value and require replay parser failure
